deviation_mechanism: The optimizer bypassed the strict monotonic chirp hypothesis because discrete multilayer optics physically favor quarter-wave-like impedance matching for broadband reflection. This is a standard physical trade-off in TMM solvers: structural discretization naturally resolves into periodic-like unit cells unless strong regularization forces smooth gradients.
